# Nikita Skliarov-Napriahlo — Full Stack Developer & Promobo

> Personal site of Nikita Skliarov-Napriahlo, full stack developer at The Freight Hero B.V. in the Netherlands and co-founder of Promobo. The page leads with the Promobo offer (subscription websites for entrepreneurs and clubs in Twente) backed by live, clickable proof. Available in Dutch (default), English, Ukrainian and Russian via ?lang=en|uk|ru.

## Offer

- Promobo: subscription websites for entrepreneurs and clubs in Twente, run in partnership with Jordi Raanhuis. One fixed monthly price covers design, build, hosting, changes and maintenance — no hourly billing. Support in Dutch, English, Ukrainian and Russian. Contact: info@promobo.nl (reply within one working day). https://promobo.nl

## Client work (all live)

- Praktijk Monique Hoedemaker: couples and family therapy practice in Hengelo. The owner edits her own content in Sanity; contact form mail arrives via Resend. Angular. https://moniquehoedemaker.com
- Prima Auto's: car dealership website, built, delivered and maintained. Next.js + Supabase. https://www.primaautos.nl
- Care of from your Heart: one-page site for an outpatient care provider in Hengelo. Angular 21 + Tailwind. https://careofyh.nl
- Jordi Raanhuis: speaker site of the Promobo co-founder, prerendered routes for SEO. Angular. https://jordiraanhuis.nl
- De Tassenkoning: 3D product configurator for a bag store (in development). Angular.

## Heavy engineering

- The Freight Hero Platform: multi-tenant freight forwarding SaaS (instant quoting, tariff engine with dozens of charge types, shipment lifecycle, Dutch VAT logic). Next.js, tRPC, Prisma, PostgreSQL. https://thefreighthero.nl / https://thefreighthero.com
- Goonys Ticket Portal + browser extension: multi-tenant ticket system; the extension automatically attaches a screenshot, DOM snapshot and console logs to a report (network capture is opt-in). In daily use at The Freight Hero via enterprise force-install. Next.js, TypeScript, WXT. https://support.goonys.nl

## Own products

- Finance Foresee: budgeting app answering one question — how much can I spend today? Next.js + Supabase. https://personal-finance-five-nu.vercel.app
- Review funnel: gets customers to a posted review in thirty seconds, no backend. https://tfh-review.vercel.app
- Goonys Analytics: cookieless multi-tenant analytics for all Goonys sites (private).
- Personal Jarvis: Telegram assistant that turns free text into actions and reminders (private).
- Story engine: branching stories on Telegram with Telegram Stars payments (private).
- cfmigrate: DNS migrations to Cloudflare with an audit/plan/apply/verify safety model (private).
- This site: four languages, strict same-origin CSP, cookieless analytics, hand-written HTML/CSS/JS with no build step. https://github.com/Nikita-Skliarov/portfolio-website

## Stack

TypeScript, Next.js/React, Angular, Vue/Nuxt, Node.js, tRPC, PHP/Laravel, Python, C#, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Prisma, Supabase, Docker, Vercel.
